LanguageData.RM_OrunGhalInspect: Toward your colony it is {0}. Studied {1} times.
LanguageData.RM_OrunGhalTierMsg: Orun-Ghal is now {0} toward your colony.
LanguageData.RM_OrunGhalFriendText: After many visits, Orun-Ghal turned and walked with {STUDIER_nameDef} back toward the colony's light, and stood there a while before going back to its rounds.\n\nThe minds that wear it know your people now. It will come to stand near them in the Deep.
